description: This file defines a PHP class 'AttendanceEditPunchOutRecordOverlapAPI' that is part of the OrangeHRM system's API. The class provides an endpoint to check for punch-out record overlaps when editing attendance records, including validation, retrieving attendance records by ID, and determining if the punch-out times overlap with existing records.

classes.name: AttendanceEditPunchOutRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: A class that provides an API endpoint to check whether editing a punch-out record results in overlapping records, supporting validation, record retrieval, time zone handling, and overlap checking mechanisms.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to check for punch-out overlap when editing attendance records by fetching record details, validating access, and performing overlap checks based on UTC times.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET endpoint parameters, including record ID, punch in/out dates and times, and timezone offsets.

methods.name: getUTCTimeByOffsetAndDateTime
methods.description: Constructs UTC DateTime objects for punch-in and punch-out times based on provided date, time, and timezone offset parameters.
